description: Tasks template for the selected modernization assessment categories.

tasks.reason: The assessment reports that the Java version is not the latest LTS.
tasks.requirements: Upgrade the application runtime and Maven configuration to Java 25, following the Java upgrade guidelines. Addresses issues: Java Version is not the latest LTS.

tasks.reason: The assessment reports that the Spring Boot version has reached the end of OSS support.
tasks.requirements: Upgrade Spring Boot to a supported 4.x version compatible with the selected Java target. Addresses issues: Spring Boot Version Has Reached the End of OSS Support.

tasks.reason: The assessment reports that the Spring Framework version has reached the end of OSS support.
tasks.requirements: Upgrade Spring Framework to a supported 7.x version and keep it compatible with the selected Spring Boot and Java versions. Addresses issues: Spring Framework Version Has Reached the End of OSS Support.

tasks.description: Secure Azure Database for PostgreSQL with Managed Identity
tasks.requirements: Prepare the application's PostgreSQL data access for Azure Database for PostgreSQL and managed identity authentication. Preserve existing database behavior. Addresses issues: PostgreSQL database found.

tasks.reason: The assessment detects Jakarta Persistence (JPA) API usage.
tasks.requirements: Migrate the selected Jakarta Persistence usage for Azure compatibility while preserving existing persistence behavior. Addresses issues: Detects usage of Jakarta Persistence (JPA) APIs.

tasks.reason: Include a dependency-security safeguard in the modernization plan.
tasks.requirements: Assess project dependencies for known CVEs and remediate findings that can be addressed without changing the selected modernization scope. Verify the resulting build and tests.

tasks.description: Containerize Java Application for Container Readiness
tasks.reason: The assessment reports that no Dockerfile was found.
tasks.requirements: Make the Java application container-ready and create the missing Dockerfile. Addresses issues: No Dockerfile found.
